mainGoal: A freshly created site ends as a CORRECT, on-brand, fully-populated site: the public homepage/article/category/page render through the design system (brand #1ba8c8 + Nunito + the 13/12 sections + hero) via the live router; the 16-step build completes and marks the site status='active'; every starter article has a category, author, hero image, SEO and a 1-hero/4-featured/4-trending/6-latest placement; AI image generation works (no response_format) and full-article text is reliable (raised timeout + retry on abort); AI presets actually drive generation; and the Presets/Editor/Settings/Pages/Categories admin tabs match the legacy reference field-by-field. This measurable, observable outcome is verified by the aggregate acceptance criteria of stories T1 through T20 (the failure criterion below is the inverse).

render-output: renderHome+renderLayout emit the 13 home-section: markers + --tw-brand.

live GET / (renderHomepageHtml composes buildHomeViewModel+renderHome+renderLayout): SERVED HTML has INLINE the 13 home-section: markers, Nunito, /assets/public.css, a hero bg image, --tw-brand — not the bare fallback.
COHERENCE: seeding T6's is_trending/is_featured flags, GET / renders counts hero=1, featured=4, trending=4, latest=6 via buildHomeViewModel (home.ts:285-315).

stories.title: Provisioning completes: in-process warm + sites.status='active'
acceptanceCriteria: BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN the 16-step provisioning job for a new site, WHEN the warm_homepage_cache step runs (STEP_KEYS index 13, fn warmHomepageCacheStep), THEN it renders the homepage in-process and stores it via putCachedHtml (no https://{host}/ self-fetch that 403s) AND the warm step does not escalate to FAILED.

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN provisioning runs to completion against a fake-D1, WHEN update_launch_readiness (STEP_KEYS index 15, today read-only) finishes, THEN a SELECT of sites.status for the new site returns 'active' (the schema CHECK-allowed live value; 'launched' is rejected by the CHECK constraint).

FUNCTIONAL (guard of existing behavior): GIVEN the step registry, WHEN provisioning reports progress, THEN total_steps equals STEP_KEYS.length (16) end-to-end. TOTAL_STEPS=STEP_KEYS.length is ALREADY 16 and the runner ALREADY re-syncs any stale stored count to TOTAL_STEPS (runner.ts:187-194) — this AC guards the existing derive+resync, it does NOT claim a 15-to-16 fix.

stories.title: Starter articles get category, default author, SEO and 1/4/4/6 placement
acceptanceCriteria: BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN provisioning inserts the 15 starter articles against a fake-D1, WHEN each articles row is SELECTed, THEN it has a non-null category_id (from the site's allocated site_categories), a non-null author_name (from the new default_author_name site_setting — NOT a user email), and non-null seo_title and seo_description.

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN the 15 starter articles, WHEN their homepage placement FLAGS are SELECTed, THEN provisioning has written exactly the flag distribution the homepage reader (buildHomeViewModel) consumes to produce the agreed 1 hero + 4 featured + 4 trending + 6 latest split (operator decision D4; the brief BCL-023 requires >=1 per bucket): exactly 4 rows is_trending=1 (→ trending=4), exactly 5 OTHER rows is_featured=1 and is_trending=0 (→ featuredBucket=5 → hero=1 + featured=4), the remaining 6 rows is_featured=0 AND is_trending=0 (→ latest=6), and homepage_rank populated on all 15 for deterministic ordering. The reader buckets PURELY from is_trending/is_featured (home.ts:285-315: is_trending=1 removed from the pool first, featuredBucket=is_featured=1 from the remainder, hero=featuredBucket[0], featured=featuredBucket.slice(1), latest=the rest ordered is_featured DESC, is_trending DESC, homepage_rank ASC); homepage_section MAY be set for admin display but is admin-editor-only and the reader IGNORES it for placement, so this AC does NOT assert homepage_section as the placement encoding.

stories.title: AI tagline/site_description overwrite stubs; seed default_author_name
acceptanceCriteria: BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN the default settings seed has written stub tagline and site_description, WHEN the AI step produces real values and upsertSiteSetting runs, THEN a SELECT of site_settings.value for 'tagline' and 'site_description' returns the AI-generated values (the UPDATE-if-null WHERE value IS NULL OR value='' guard no longer silently discards them).

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN provisioning seeds site settings, WHEN settings are SELECTed, THEN a default_author_name setting exists for the site (so T6 sources the article author from it, not from a user email).

stories.title: Seed brand_tokens_json from the brand contract family (not the dark palette)
acceptanceCriteria: BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN provisioning seeds site_settings, WHEN brand_tokens_json is SELECTed, THEN its parsed value is either the brand contract family (primary in the #1ba8c8 / teal family) or empty so the design defaults apply — it is NEVER the old mismatched dark palette {primary:'#0F172A', accent:'#38BDF8', neutral:'#F8FAFC'}.

stories.title: Correct vertical->category allocation and link articles to categories
acceptanceCriteria: BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN a parenting-vertical site is provisioned against a fake-D1, WHEN site_categories are SELECTed, THEN the allocated categories are parenting-appropriate (not the mismatched family-travel/healthy-meals/wellness set).

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN the starter articles and allocated categories, WHEN each category's article_count is computed via a SELECT join, THEN articles are linked to the allocated site_categories so category_count > 0 (category pages and chips are no longer empty).

stories.title: Fix AI image generation: remove response_format; parse b64_json AND url
acceptanceCriteria: BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN the image-generation client, WHEN generateImage builds the request body for gpt-image-2 (model id UNCHANGED — locked by the brief), THEN the serialized request body contains NO response_format key (the parameter gpt-image-2 rejects with 400 'Unknown parameter: response_format').

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN an image API response, WHEN the parser reads data[0], THEN it returns image bytes for BOTH shapes: a b64_json response AND a url response (data[0].b64_json ?? fetch(data[0].url)) — defensive regardless of which the API returns.

stories.title: Reliable full-article text: raise per-article timeout + retry on abort
acceptanceCriteria: BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN the article-generation path, WHEN generateStarterArticle calls the text client, THEN it passes a timeoutMs larger than the 30_000ms DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS (using the existing timeoutMs knob) so a full article is not aborted at 30s.

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN a text request that times out / aborts, WHEN the retry classifier runs, THEN an aborted/timed-out call is retried (timeout/abort added to the retriable set alongside isRetriableStatus 429/5xx), not surfaced immediately as a fallback stub.

acceptanceCriteria: STRUCTURAL (integration wiring): the admin presets entry api/src/admin/templates/presets.ts composes the presets screen via renderPresets, which now emits the reference preset form (name="category" dropdown, system/user prompt fields, content-mapping) — proving the upgraded form is wired into the live presets template the handler emits, not an orphaned fragment.

renderPresets emits Name, Description, a REQUIRED name="category" dropdown (use-case categories), System+User prompts, variable chips, Fields-to-Generate map; NOT name="category" type="text" NOR name="variables".
new migration, local D1: PRAGMA table_info(prompt_presets) shows system_prompt_template, user_prompt_template, content_mapping.
render-output: renderShell emits the chrome hosting the Presets tab.

generateStarterArticlePlan (text.ts:478) on 'outline' and generateStarterArticle (text.ts:540) on 'content' (the legacy content-path keys) each resolve a preset by category and use its prompt/model; with no preset, fall back to the existing builder (no crash, no stub).

migration 0016 on a local D1: prompt_presets has default is_system=1 presets for the FULL enum (title/excerpt/outline/content/seo/image/custom) so EVERY lookup resolves; seed idempotent (INSERT-OR-IGNORE); fresh site otherwise ZERO rows.
render-output: renderHome via renderLayout emits the design home sections surfacing preset-driven articles (selection asserted by T13-AC1).

stories.title: Homepage meta description from site_settings.site_description
acceptanceCriteria: BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN a provisioned site whose site_settings.site_description is set, WHEN the live router handles GET /, THEN the homepage <meta name=description> equals the site's stored site_description — not the hard-coded `Latest articles on ${hostname}` text.

BEHAVIORAL (render-output, ui_visual_parity): GIVEN the design homepage template renderHome composed by renderLayout, WHEN the home view model renders, THEN the rendered HTML head carries a <meta name=description> populated from the view model's description field (the design template emits the meta the route now feeds the real site_description into).

stories.title: Gate public serving + indexing on sites.status='active'
acceptanceCriteria: BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN a site whose status is 'draft' (not active), WHEN the live router handles GET /, THEN the request returns 404 (not served as a live public homepage, therefore inherently not indexable); GIVEN an 'active' site, WHEN GET / is handled, THEN it IS served (200). The gate is added in the single place the site is resolved — resolveSiteByHostname (site-context.ts:63) today filters only WHERE d.hostname=? AND d.status='active' (site-context.ts:83-87), gating on the DOMAIN status not the SITE status; the fix adds AND s.status='active' to that one query so a non-active site resolves to NULL, and publicSiteContextMiddleware (middleware.ts:48-58) already 404s a null context — confining the change to site-context.ts (middleware.ts/router.ts carry NO site-status logic).

stories.title: Consistency: total_steps=16, favicon, and record PREVIEW_SECRET ops task
acceptanceCriteria: BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN the public router, WHEN GET /favicon.ico is handled, THEN it returns a served favicon or a 204 (no unhandled 404/500).

FUNCTIONAL (guard of existing behavior): GIVEN the provisioning runner, WHEN it reports the step total, THEN TOTAL_STEPS / total_steps is 16. TOTAL_STEPS=STEP_KEYS.length is already 16 and the runner already re-syncs any stale stored count (runner.ts:187-194) — this AC guards that existing behavior. The PREVIEW_SECRET fix is recorded as an operator ops task for the ship hand-off (owner=user), with NO develop code for the secret since the noindex/no-store draft render already works.
